lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Whoa! Jabu, look at that tree! Its tummy is bigger than yours!
lines.text: Hawu! Jabu, jonga laa mthi! Isisu sawo sikhulu kunesakho!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Okay, okay. Maybe not bigger. But why is the trunk so wide?
lines.text: Kulungile, kulungile. Mhlawumbi asisikhulu. Kodwa kutheni isiqu sawo sibanzi kangaka?

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: We need berries for our jam. One basket for us, and one little bowl to share.
lines.text: Sifuna amaqunube ukuze senze ijam yethu. Ingobozi enye yeyethu, nesitya esincinci sokwabelana.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Let’s count together. One, two, three, four, five!
lines.text: Masibale kunye. Nye, mbini, ntathu, nne, ntlanu!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Jabu, your trunk is the fastest berry-picker I’ve ever seen.
lines.text: Jabu, umboko wakho ngowona ukhawulezayo ukukha amaqunube endakha ndawubona.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: First, bowl. Then berries. Then mash. Then stir. In that order!
lines.text: Kuqala, isitya. Emva koko amaqunube. Emva koko siyawatyumza. Emva koko siyaxuba. Ngolo landelelwano!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Catch the purple one! No, the other purple one!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Well... that did not go to plan.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: But we can fix it. We’ll pick up, clean up, and try again.
lines.text: Kodwa singakulungisa. Siza kuchola, sicoce, size sizame kwakhona.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: You gather. I sort. Then we both stir.
lines.text: Wena qokelela. Mna ndohlule. Emva koko sixube sobabini.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Look! A small pot of jam and a very big adventure.
lines.text: Jonga! Imbiza encinci yejam kunye nohambo olukhulu kakhulu.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Baobabs grow in several parts of Africa. Their thick trunks can store lots of water, which helps them through dry times.
lines.text: Imithi ye-baobab ikhula kwiindawo ezininzi zaseAfrika. Iziqu zayo ezinkulu zinokugcina amanzi amaninzi, nto leyo eyinceda ngamaxesha omileyo.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Africa is full of different places, people, plants and stories. We’ll discover another one next time.
lines.text: IAfrika izele ziindawo, ngabantu, zizityalo namabali ahlukeneyo. Siza kufumanisa elinye kwixesha elizayo.
